children: Lion Copper filed an independent NI 43-101 technical report supporting the maiden Bear Mineral Resource Estimate, detailing 6.71 billion lbs Indicated and 8.77 billion lbs Inferred contained copper.
Filed NI 43-101 Technical Report (effective July 21, 2026) supporting the Bear maiden MRE announced Aug 4, 2026.
Bear MRE: Indicated 1,064 Mt @ 0.29% Cu = 6.71 billion lbs contained copper.
Bear MRE: Inferred 1,770 Mt @ 0.22% Cu = 8.77 billion lbs contained copper.
Bear is contiguous with Yerington Project, adding long-term resource optionality and leveraging planned infrastructure.
Company advancing Definitive Feasibility Study and permitting for Yerington, DFS on schedule for Q1 2027.
